headline: UK House Prices Fall at Steepest Rate in Over Three Years on High Rates
summary: UK house prices fell by 0.6% in October, marking the steepest annual fall in more than three years and bringing the average property price to £296,285 according to Lloyds, as high mortgage rates hit the market.
why: Residential property price indices and mortgage data from major lenders like Lloyds provide key insights into consumer housing affordability and real estate sector health.

impacts.name: UK Real Estate Sector
impacts.why: Rising mortgage rates directly depress property valuations and transaction volumes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
